# thetalake_user (Data Source)

The user data source enables lookup of user IDs by email address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thetalake_user" "example" {
  email = "user@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the user to look up

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The user ID
- `name` (String) The name of the user
